title: Ang Kak and Ginger Chicken Soup
ldName: Ang Kak and Ginger Chicken Soup
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 free range chicken (Indonesian: ayam kampung), cut into 4 pieces
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a boil over a medium heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 1 hour. Divide into four soup bowls and serve warm.
htmlIngredientLines: 1 free range chicken (Indonesian: ayam kampung), cut into 4 pieces
